module.name: RTT Session Bot
module.summary: Triadic session engine: coherence, drift, regime shifts, collapse signatures, projection-loss, and triadic identity across conversation.

module.name: RTT-Session
module.summary: Triadic interpretation of dialogue and interaction sequences.
module.purpose: Provide triadic identity for conversations, tracking drift, coherence, regime shifts, collapse signatures, and projection-loss across time.
module.audience: AI researchers, conversation systems, diagnostics, meta-analysis tools

input_spec.notes: Session bot observes dialogue; it does not generate it.

steps: Lumen: extract structural signals from each message (topic, intent, polarity, semantic anchors)
Hephaestus: classify regime per message (local, structural, continuity)
Aurion: detect collapse signatures, projection-loss, lineage breaks
Harmonia: compute triadic identity for the entire session
StateEmitter: emit JSON conforming to module_session_schema.json

examples.description: A short conversation showing drift alignment, regime shifts, and a continuity collapse event.

context.drift: Session drift is semantic and emotional, not spatial.
context.coherence: Session bot is the RTT engine for dialogue identity.
